background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game background for an original mobile 16-bit pixel game Demon King's Bakery. Wide landscape 3:2. Very SIMPLE low-contrast muted sage green grass courtyard, pale blue sky in upper third, a couple of blocky cream clouds, distant soft hills, a modest small gray castle silhouette far top-left to suggest demon king and heroes, a simple wooden fence across back. Foreground bottom two-thirds mostly EMPTY flat muted tan courtyard for gameplay devices and a walkable demon character. Chunky crisp 16-bit pixel clusters, restrained warm earthy palette, simple flat readable shapes. Minimal objects and detail, no busy flowers or textures, no glow, no nebula or fantasy crystals, no dramatic depth, no foreground machinery or trees or people or baked goods. Background intentionally subdued to contrast bold opaque interactive sprites. No typography or labels or UI or watermark. Front three-quarter view with ground flat and unobstructed, clear broad work area. Use simple large pixel clusters, no painterly blur.

atlas.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game production sprite atlas, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Original cute Demon King's Bakery, crisp chunky 16-bit pixel art, NOT smooth cartoon and NOT detailed realistic pixel painting. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows regular grid, 16 isolated sprites, one per cell, transparent generous empty margins, NO borders or cell backgrounds or text. All opaque subjects, bold DARK outline, bright clear saturated everyday colors, simple silhouettes readable at 40 pixels, consistent three-quarter FRONT view, tiny grounded shadow only under each object. Row 1 LEFT TO RIGHT: a compact rectangular patch of ripe golden WHEAT with a small wooden edging; a cute white black-spotted COW beside a milk pail and hay (full body); a compact green bush with large RED BERRIES; a squat brick BREAD OVEN with visibly glowing warm opening and a loaf at opening. Row 2: a wooden BREAD SALES COUNTER with red/cream striped awning and big loaves plus a coin jar, no lettering; a simple open wooden ingredient CRATE containing wheat, milk bottle, berries; a cute small friendly purple DEMON KING CHEF front view, full body, obvious two ivory horns, white chef hat, red apron, short dark cape, standing; SAME demon king chef facing RIGHT full body, walking pose with one foot forward, recognizable identical hat horns apron. Row 3: SAME demon king chef facing RIGHT walking opposite foot forward; a friendly tiny armored KNIGHT customer holding a sword facing left full body; a friendly tiny MAGE customer with pointed blue hat facing left full body; a friendly tiny RANGER customer green cape bow facing left full body. Row 4: a large simple golden ordinary BREAD LOAF with three cuts; a soft pale golden MILK BREAD ROLL; a round golden BERRY BUN with visible RED jam center; a compact wooden wheeled HANDCART carrying wheat and a milk bottle (transport upgrade icon). Important no sprite bleeds into another cell, all fully contained, side-facing characters exactly same pixel density and body size. No star machines, no crystals, no complicated ornaments, no labels, no checkered transparency.

postprocess: node tools/bakery-art.mjs: atlas grid crop, alpha trim, nearest-neighbor 144 px lossless WebP; background 768×512. Original alpha preserved.
